company.name: ShowNo Towels
company.one_liner: A 3-in-1 towel that becomes a changing cover, so you can change at the beach or pool.

facts.summary: A mom invented a wearable towel that works as a towel, a changing cover and a wrap, for families at pools, beaches and water parks.
highlights: It works as a towel, a wrap and a private changing cover.
Parents and swimmers are the target customers.
So far it's sold in small quantities, mostly one at a time.
She needs a partner for manufacturing and big retail orders.

real_deal.summary: Lori Greiner offered $75,000 for 25% (a $300K value), but the final agreement never went through.

outcome.headline: A theme-park order didn't repeat, and the business closed.
outcome.story: ShowNo got into water parks for a while, but the orders didn't come back and the investor deal never finalized. The founder struggled to get big production contracts and the company is no longer in business.
